how_to_run: Give each prompt to the client with the skill installed (fresh chat). Pass = the client builds a URL matching expected_url_contains, runs it (or hands it over if egress is blocked), and the reported row count is within ±30% of expected_rows (OSDR grows). Also check the behaviour notes.

cases.prompt: List all mouse RNA-seq datasets in OSDR.
cases.behaviour: Reports ~111 distinct OSD accessions; mentions version/citation note.

cases.prompt: Which OSDR datasets come from the RR-1 mission, and what assays and tissues do they include?
cases.behaviour: Regex is anchored so RR-10…RR-18 are excluded; 25 datasets.

cases.prompt: Find female mouse liver samples.
cases.behaviour: Uses samples (not assays) because per-sample rows are wanted; if it had tried the factor field first and got 0 rows it must retry with the characteristic.

cases.prompt: Get the significantly differentially expressed genes (adj p < 0.05) for space flight vs ground control in OSD-515.
cases.behaviour: Two-step: lists files (or contrasts) first, pins ONE exact file name (non-rRNArm), selects columns rather than column.* for the whole table. Does not return a 422.

cases.prompt: Which datasets have both RNA-seq differential expression results and DNA methylation data?
cases.behaviour: Runs two cheap queries and intersects id.accession (never both filters in one URL). Distinguishes 'has a methylation assay + DE file' (~16: OSD-47, 48, 49, 98…397) from 'has both processed DE and DM tables' (4: OSD-47, 48, 103, 105) and says which it answered.

cases.prompt: What sex, strain and age information is recorded for OSD-104?
cases.behaviour: Discovers that age is stored as 'age at launch' (16 week), sex Female, strain C57BL/6J — via a bare study.characteristics prefix, not by guessing field names.

cases.prompt: Give me the download link for the differential expression file of OSD-168.
cases.behaviour: Prefixes the relative remote_url with https://osdr.nasa.gov.

cases.prompt: Which 16S datasets have differential abundance tables?
cases.behaviour: Mentions that three method-specific files (ancombc1, ancombc2, deseq2) exist per dataset.

cases.prompt: Show me the temperature and CO2 readings on ISS during RR-1.
cases.behaviour: FIRST sentence states environmental telemetry is outside this skill and gives the EDA link https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/eda/. Builds NO biodata URL and does NOT probe /eda/api or any other API.

cases.prompt: How many Arabidopsis microarray datasets are there?
cases.behaviour: Counts distinct id.accession client-side (no count endpoint).

cases.prompt: List all human astronaut datasets in OSDR.
cases.behaviour: FIRST sentence: 'OSDR does not host NASA human astronaut data', immediately followed by the NLSP (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/nlsp/), LSDA and LSAH links. Only then may it offer OSDR's human-related holdings (Inspiration4 non-NASA crew, ground analogs, in-vitro), each labelled as such.

cases.prompt: Which datasets are from any Rodent Research mission?
cases.behaviour: Uses an anchored regex; an unanchored /RR/ returns ~240 (matches 'Irradiation') and is a fail.

cases.prompt: List all amplicon sequencing datasets where a plant was the host organism.
cases.behaviour: Filters on study.characteristics.host organism (organism is 'Microbiota'); ~11 datasets: OSD-267, 268, 269, 385, 386, 412, 413, 414, 766, 772, 773.

cases.prompt: Get the differentially expressed genes for flight vs ground in OSD-48 with adj p < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1.
cases.behaviour: Reads the contrasts file, finds two flight-vs-ground pairs (Carcass; Upon euthanasia), LISTS them and ASKS the user which to use instead of choosing. Once chosen: ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Log2fc, Adj.p.value<=0.05, Stat and Group.Mean/Stdev of both groups; count of significant genes; top-10 up and top-10 down by log2FC; ends by asking whether the user wants a CSV of all significant genes. (Carcass pair: 635 significant.)

cases.prompt: Which subjects (animals) appear in both OSD-102 and OSD-104, and what tissues and assays does each have?
cases.behaviour: Builds subject ID = project identifier | source name (e.g. RR-1 | RR1_FLT_M23); 12 subjects, kidney + soleus; excludes pooled/QC samples.

cases.prompt: Which Rodent Research datasets used only female mice?
cases.behaviour: Classifies per dataset from sample rows (all sexes == female, ignoring Not Applicable) → 89 datasets; lists accessions; RRRM-1 (RR-8) and RR-8 merged into one mission row.

cases.prompt: I need physical tissue samples from the RR-9 mice for my own assay — how do I get them from OSDR?
cases.behaviour: First sentence says biospecimen requests are outside this skill and gives the NBISC link; no biodata query.

cases.prompt: Show me the differentially expressed genes for OSD-515, space flight vs ground control.
cases.behaviour: Single-factor comparison → exactly one contrast, no question needed. Output: ENSEMBL, SYMBOL, Log2fc, Adj.p.value (≤0.05), Stat, Group.Mean/Stdev for both groups; 3,947 significant; top-10 up and top-10 down; ends by asking whether the user wants a CSV.

cases.prompt: Which genes are differentially expressed in OSD-95 in space flight vs ground at 25 µg/mL?
cases.behaviour: Microbe study: the DE table has gene_id and no SYMBOL. Per SKILL.md §6 C the skill reads the header, lists the available non-sample columns and asks which to include (or, if the user already specified, uses gene_id, Log2fc, Adj.p.value, Stat, group mean/stdev). 1,493 significant rows for the 25 µg/mL flight-vs-ground contrast.

cases.prompt: Tell me about OSD-248: what was studied, what are the treatment groups and how many samples in each?
cases.behaviour: Title/description from the tree; 58 samples; 6 groups = distinct combinations of the 4 factors (spaceflight, duration, euthanasia location, dissection condition) with n (10/10/9/9/10/10); lists processed files; DOI.

cases.prompt: List all Drosophila datasets with their titles.
cases.behaviour: Uses investigation.study.study%20title as a bare column (investigation.study.title is not a field); 17 accessions with titles.

cases.prompt: list all inspiration 4 datasets that contain data files
cases.behaviour: ONE call with bare &file.category (no GeneLab-processed / fastqc filter — the user did not say 'processed'). Reports all 10 Inspiration4 datasets (OSD-569–575, 630, 656, 687) with their file categories.

cases.prompt: List the differentially expressed genes for OSD-145 flight vs ground control comparison, filtered to adj p < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1
cases.behaviour: Uses the differential_EXPRESSION file (microbial RNA-seq; not differential abundance). Reads the contrasts file; the only flight-vs-ground contrast is (Space Flight & Frozen)v(Ground Control & Frozen) so it proceeds without asking, and never offers a contrast that is not a column in that file (there is no 'Not frozen' spaceflight group). Requests column.SYMBOL as usual; the 500 means this microbe table has none, so it reruns the same URL without SYMBOL (does not treat 500 as a missing dataset). Tables show gene_id as the first column, then log2FC, adj p, Stat, group mean/SD. 1,513 at adj p ≤ 0.05; 239 with |log2FC| > 1 (168 up, 71 down). Ends with the CSV offer.
